d:
Ahir Shah is Jimmy Carr’s guest this week! And Ahir’s subgenre is… Class Is In Session.
So we’re talking classic high school movies, why we like watching adults play teenagers, and the weird things we thought were normal thirty years ago. Ahir manages to pull out a hell of a concept for a film. But we have to wait 20 years to release it - will it be worth the wait? Enjoy!
